title: How NOT to Hide in a Restroom: Man Claims He Was “Praying”
description:
On August 29th, 2022, at around 6:43 pm, officers responded to a dispatch call at a local business where a man refused to leave the bathroom after business hours.

On arrival, the officers spoke to a staff member, who told officers the man had entered the bathroom 15 minutes before closing and told the staff member he was busy but stopped responding.

The suspect was arrested and later charged with Public Intoxication and Resisting Arrest.
